Caála|Recreativo da Caála]] (11) | longest losses = [[Domant FC|Domant]] (6) | matches = 240 | total goals = 514 | prevseason = [[2014 Girabola|2014]] | nextseason = [[2016 Girabola|2016]] | updated = 10 October 2015 }} The '''2015 [[Girabola]]''' was the 37th season of top-tier football in [[Angola]]. The season ran from 11 February to 10 October 2015. [[C.R.D. Libolo|Recreativo do Libolo]] survived a late-season scare from [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|1º de Agosto]] to win their fourth Angolan championship, all in the past five years. [[C.R.D. Libolo|Recreativo do Libolo]] needed a scoreless draw against [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica do Lobito]] in their final game to finish in a tie atop the standings with [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|1º de Agosto]], who closed the season with six straight wins. [[C.R.D. Libolo|Recreativo do Libolo]] won the tiebreaker based on head-to-head points. The league comprised 16 of teams and the bottom three were relegated to the 2016 [[Segundona]].{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ango2011.html |title=Angola 2011 |date=6 May 2011 |access-date=20 May 2011 |author=King, Ian}} [[Domant FC|Domant]], [[F.C. Bravos do Maquis|Onze Bravos]] and [[Sporting Clube de Cabinda|Sporting de Cabinda]] finished in the last three spots and were relegated. ==Teams== A total of 16 teams contested the league, including 13 sides from the [[2014 Girabola|2014 season]] and three promoted from the 2014 [[Segundona]], [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica do Lobito]], [[Domant FC|Domant]] and [[Progresso da Lunda Sul|Progresso Lunda Sul]]. [[C.R.D. Libolo|Recreativo do Libolo]] were the defending champions from the [[2014 Girabola|2014 season]]. ==Changes from 2014 season== '''Relegated''': [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]], [[S.L.
